related.title: LiteRT INT8：零點、尺度與量化誤差
related.titleEn: LiteRT INT8: zero points, scales and quantization error
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：超限在建立前被拒絕，非整倍數正確，無GPU時仍能完成小型示範。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Oversized tiles are rejected before creation, irregular shapes pass, and small demos work without a GPU.
related.difference: 正確處理零點與範圍，量化前後誤差按同一實值尺度比較。
related.differenceEn: Handle zero point and range correctly, and compare quantization errors in real-value units.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 兩個B×B FP32輸入tile需8B² bytes workgroup儲存；此預算不含其他共享變數。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 教學adapter可用共享容量16 KiB，B32，每元素4 bytes，工作組執行緒數另檢查。 需要8×32²/1024=8 KiB，尚餘8 KiB；不能由容量通過推論執行緒限制也通過。
x≈(q−z)s，q=round(x/s)+z再限制到整數範圍；無飽和時最近捨入誤差≤s/2。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 s=0.02、z=−3，x=0.31；最近捨入遇中點採ties-to-even，量化範圍−128..127。 x/s=15.5→16，q=13，還原(13+3)×0.02=0.32，誤差0.01。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: TwoB×B FP32 tiles require8B² bytes of workgroup storage, excluding other shared variables. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Teaching adapter storage 16 KiB, B32, 4 bytes/value; thread-count limits are checked separately. Storage 8 KiB, leaving8 KiB; capacity passing does not establish thread-count validity.

x≈(q−z)s, with q=round(x/s)+z clipped to integer range; without saturation, error≤s/2. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. s0.02, z−3, x0.31, nearest ties-to-even rounding and range−128..127. 15.5 rounds16, q13, reconstruction0.32, error0.01.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: AI 加速器巨作總驗收：學徒導師的有效服務量
related.titleEn: AI-accelerator capstone: useful service for an apprentice mentor
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：超限在建立前被拒絕，非整倍數正確，無GPU時仍能完成小型示範。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Oversized tiles are rejected before creation, irregular shapes pass, and small demos work without a GPU.
related.difference: 將正確、具來源且準時的回答計為有效服務，避免只以生成token速度排名。
related.differenceEn: Count correct, sourced, on-time answers as useful service rather than ranking by token speed alone.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 兩個B×B FP32輸入tile需8B² bytes workgroup儲存；此預算不含其他共享變數。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 教學adapter可用共享容量16 KiB，B32，每元素4 bytes，工作組執行緒數另檢查。 需要8×32²/1024=8 KiB，尚餘8 KiB；不能由容量通過推論執行緒限制也通過。
goodput=同時通過所有要求的請求數/時間；不能把各條件通過率直接相乘，除非有獨立性證據。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 60 s內完成120題，其中逐題核對後90題同時符合來源、工程答案與5 s期限。 原始完成率120/60=2題/s；有效服務90/60=1.5題/s。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: TwoB×B FP32 tiles require8B² bytes of workgroup storage, excluding other shared variables. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Teaching adapter storage 16 KiB, B32, 4 bytes/value; thread-count limits are checked separately. Storage 8 KiB, leaving8 KiB; capacity passing does not establish thread-count validity.

Goodput=jointly passing requests/time; do not multiply marginal pass rates without independence evidence. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. In60 s, 120 questions complete; per-request audit finds90 jointly meet source, engineering-answer and 5 s deadline criteria. Raw throughput2 questions/s; goodput1.5 questions/s.
